stem.text: The diagram shows a blood capillary and the tissue fluid which surrounds it.

stem.alt: Diagram of a blood capillary running horizontally between two grey tissue fluid regions, with points labelled W, X, Y and Z, arteriole end on the left and venule end on the right.

stem.text: Tissue fluid is formed when fluid and solutes from blood plasma pass through tiny gaps in the capillary wall. Most tissue fluid is then returned to the blood in the capillary.
Which pressures will be needed at points W, X, Y and Z so that this system can function?
